research_window.note: Continuous scan from the exact committed editorial boundary found two material same-event judicial developments and no qualifying new record.

publication_authorization: Authorized scheduled maintenance of the National Trump Record. Publication remains subject to deterministic validation, CI and the repository's final human acceptance gate; no AI output is treated as evidence.

changes.summary: The Ninth Circuit dismissed DOJ's emergency California ballot appeal and denied mandamus as premature, without deciding the merits.
changes.duplicate_review: The decision advances the same California ballot-list litigation already preserved in the stable election-enforcement record, so it was consolidated rather than counted separately.

changes.summary: A federal judge issued a preliminary injunction against additional East Potomac tree damage and imposed a ten-business-day notice requirement; Trump announced an appeal.
changes.duplicate_review: The order and appeal statement are later stages of the same East Potomac removal and redevelopment dispute, so the stable record was refreshed.

withheld.title: New Truth Social nursing, campaign and linked-content posts
withheld.reason: The nursing statement duplicated an existing record; the endorsement was campaign-only; and a bare RSBN link supplied no independently inspected qualifying action. One nursing video remained unavailable for visual review.

withheld.title: Trump TV October 26 late-evening listings
withheld.reason: Four new official library listings were metadata-inspected, but footage, audio and captions were not retrieved. Three were gaggles/replays and one was a 30-second edited clip; no qualifying new item was located in the material reviewed.

withheld.title: External archive discovery inputs
withheld.reason: Verified upstream measurements were refreshed without automatically promoting or summing unlike record units.

source_inspections.origin_group: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
source_inspections.evidence_extract: A 2-1 panel dismissed the emergency appeal and denied mandamus because the district court had not entered an appealable order or been given adequate opportunity to rule. Separate concurrences discussed election-administration disruption and federal authority; the dissent would have required segregation. The disposition did not resolve the underlying merits.
source_inspections.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact normalized evidence extract retained here, not a claim of hashing the complete source document.

The findings are preliminary rather than a final merits judgment.
